why: The fallback padding on `.ui-btn` is the only padding source for a control that carries no size variant. Today that is exactly one state: `hud.ts` removes `ui-btn--primary` from `.hud-new-game` for the tertiary "Start New Campaign", and `.hud-new-game--tertiary` sets only a font size and an opacity. Dropping this declaration puts that button back on the UA default, which rendered 158x44 with about 6px of horizontal padding against 16 vertical once issue #686's 44px floor made the box tall -- the lopsided edges the floor exposed. Nothing else moves, because every other `.ui-btn` is padded or sized by a later rule, which is exactly why a reviewer could delete this line and see the rest of the suite stay green.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole pads a control that carries no size variant (issue #686)
